title: DNA Extraction Using Qiagen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit
author: Lauren Rodriguez
materials: Qiagen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit

steps.title: Thaw filters and label
steps.instruction: Remove filters from the freezer, allow them to thaw at room temperature for 45 minutes, and ensure all filter capsules are properly closed and labeled.

steps.title: Agitate lysate by inversion
steps.instruction: Invert the filter capsules a couple of times to agitate the lysate.

steps.title: Incubate filters at 56 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the filter capsules at 56 °C for 3 hours, inverting the filters every 30 minutes.

steps.title: Label collection tubes
steps.instruction: Label 2 mL screw‑cap tubes or microcentrifuge tubes for each sample.

steps.title: Evacuate lysis buffer with syringe
steps.instruction: Using a 2 or 3 mL syringe, push 1 mL of air into the filter capsule while holding it horizontally, then evacuate the lysis buffer while holding the capsule vertically.

substeps.instruction: Push 1 mL air into capsule (horizontal orientation).
Draw out the lysis buffer (vertical orientation).

steps.title: Transfer sample to labeled tube
steps.instruction: Add the sample from the syringe (0.5 – 2 mL) to the associated labeled tube.

steps.title: Vortex and add Buffer AL and ethanol
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube for 15 seconds, add 200 µL Buffer AL, vortex again for 15 seconds, then add 200 µL ethanol (96‑100 %).

steps.title: Load mixture onto spin column
steps.instruction: Pipette the entire mixture, including any precipitate, into a labeled DNeasy Mini spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge to bind DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 6000 × g for 1 minute (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Place the spin column into a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW1, and centrifuge at 6000 × g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Place the spin column into a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW2, and centrifuge at 20 000 × g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Dry spin column membrane
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through and collection tube, ensuring the spin‑column membrane is completely dry (no residual ethanol).

steps.title: Add Buffer AE, incubate, and elute (first)
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a clean 1.5 or 2 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 200 µL Buffer AE onto the membrane, incubate at room temperature for 1 minute, then centrifuge at 6000 × g for 1 minute to elute.

steps.title: Repeat incubation and centrifugation (second elution)
steps.instruction: Repeat the incubation (1 minute at room temperature) and centrifugation (6000 × g for 1 minute). Do not elute more than 200 µL into the 1.5 mL tube, as excess volume contacts the membrane.
